blocks.text: Lower respiratory tract infections mein pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, lung abscess (lung mein peep ki thaili) aur bronchitis shamil hain.

Pneumonia saans ka ek acute (achanak hone wala) infection hai jo halki se le kar jaan lewa beemari tak bana sakta hai. Pneumonia mein ek ya dono lungs ke alveoli mein sozish hoti hai aur woh peep (pus) aur fluid se bhar jate hain. Is se saans lena dardnaak ho jata hai aur oxygen kam andar jati hai. Pneumonia aksar virus ya bacteria se hota hai. Duniya bhar mein bachon ki maut ki sab se badi infectious (lagne wali) wajah yahi hai.

blocks.title: Bachon mein pneumonia
blocks.text: 2017 mein pneumonia se paanch saal se kam umar ke 808 000 se zyada bachay faut hue; yeh paanch saal se kam umar ke bachon ki tamam amwat (deaths) ka 15% tha.

blocks.alt: Ek phephra jis ka nichla hissa gehra hai jahan pneumonia ka asar hai. Do bare kiye boxes: normal alveoli, patli deewar aur khali; aur pneumonia wale alveoli, moti soozi hui deewaron ke saath aur peep (pus) aur mayah se bhare hue.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pneumonia mein alveoli mein hawa ki jagah peep aur fluid bhar jata hai, is liye oxygen khoon tak kam pohanchti hai aur saans lena mushkil hota hai.
Kai jaraseem pneumonia kar sakte hain: zyada tar bacteria (khaas tor par Streptococcus pneumoniae) ya viruses (jaise human rhinovirus), aur kabhi kabhar fungi.
Alamaat: balgham wali khansi, saans phoolna, seene mein dard, bukhar, jild ka neela padna, bhook kam lagna, dil ki tez dhadkan (high heart rate) aur thakan.

Ilaj: bacteria wale pneumonia mein khaas antibiotics di jati hain. Bukhar aur dard kam karne ke liye analgesics (dard ki dawaein) bhi di jati hain. Vaccination (teeke) bachon aur badon dono ko kuch bacterial aur viral pneumonias se bachate hain.

Tuberculosis (TB) ek chronic (lambi chalne wali) infection hai jo bacteria Mycobacterium tuberculosis se hoti hai. Yeh jism ke kai hisson ko mutasir kar sakti hai magar aam tor par lungs ko karti hai. Lungs ki TB ko pulmonary tuberculosis kehte hain. Yeh bohat tezi se lagne wali (contagious) hai aur khansi ya chheenk se phailti hai. Bacteria lungs mein ja kar barhte hain aur lung ke tissue, alveoli samet, mein sozish aur nuqsan karte hain. Alveoli ke nuqsan se lung mein chhote khane (cavities) ya surakh ban sakte hain, jin se lungs theek kaam nahi kar pate. Aakhri marhale mein alveoli itne kharab ho jate hain ke lungs jism ko kaafi oxygen nahi de pate. Is halat ko respiratory failure kehte hain, jo medical emergency hai.

blocks.alt: Trachea aur dono phephre; baen phephre (tasveer mein daen) ke oopri hisse mein kai gehre surakh hain, yeh tuberculosis ke banaye hue cavities hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.13: TB se mutasir phephra (textbook ki Figure 10.13 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Alamaat: khoon wali khansi, aksar shaam ko aane jane wala bukhar, raat ko paseena, wazan kam hona, anorexia (bhook khatam hona), depression (udaasi), kamzori, sookhi khansi, aur lungs ki pleura ki sozish se seene mein dard.
Ilaj: kai antibiotics ek saath lambe arse tak (aam tor par 6 mahine) baqaidgi se lena.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Kitab TB ke ilaj ki muddat 9 mahine likhti hai; yeh bhi ek maana hua course hai. Aaj WHO ka aam ilaj 6 mahine ka hai: pehle 2 mahine chaar antibiotics, phir 4 mahine do antibiotics. Asal baat yeh hai ke kai dawaein lambe arse tak baqaidgi se leni hain.
